endpoints.description: Query only notifications sent by the calling app.
endpoints.name: View sent notifications
endpoints.note_to_user: Authorizes application actions on the calling application’s own notifications and subscriptions. Recipient enrollment and user authority remain separate.

endpoints.description: Change overall read state for the calling app’s sent notifications; delivery acknowledgments remain separate.
endpoints.name: Mark sent notifications read or unread
endpoints.note_to_user: Authorizes application actions on the calling application’s own notifications and subscriptions. Recipient enrollment and user authority remain separate.

endpoints.description: Query subscriptions for the calling application; no user identity is represented by this ATA token.
endpoints.name: View notification subscriptions
endpoints.note_to_user: Authorizes application actions on the calling application’s own notifications and subscriptions. Recipient enrollment and user authority remain separate.

endpoints.description: Revoke subscriptions belonging to the calling application; this does not enroll recipients or grant user authority.
endpoints.name: Revoke a notification subscription
endpoints.note_to_user: Authorizes application actions on the calling application’s own notifications and subscriptions. Recipient enrollment and user authority remain separate.

endpoints.description: Send the calling app’s registered event type to a consenting recipient with an active subscription.
endpoints.name: Send a notification
endpoints.note_to_user: Authorizes application actions on the calling application’s own notifications and subscriptions. Recipient enrollment and user authority remain separate.
